name: value-utilities/sizing
description: Width/height/min/max/size utilities. Mirrors `corePlugins.js`'s `width: createUtilityPlugin('width', [['w', ['width']]])`, etc. Includes the spacing scale, the fraction ramps (1/2..5/6, 1/12..11/12 for width), `auto`, `full`, viewport (`screen`/`svh`/`lvh`/`dvh`), the min/max/fit content keywords, the `xs..7xl` max-width scale, the `screen-sm..screen-2xl` `breakpoints(theme('screens'))` expansions, and arbitrary `[…]` values with math-operator normalize.
